You were lost in the forest and after hours trudging at the snow, you finally collapsed as you lay there weakly.

A pair of white furry boots approached you and you look up to see the Winter Prince gazing at you as his white fur coat fluttered in the wind.

"You seemed lost, traveler," He spoke stoicly. "Come, I'll take you to my winter castle."
